## New

- **At a Glance → Size → Auto: one row, two when there's more.** The card shows just the date, and grows to a second row when there's something to show: an alarm, the flashlight, an event. It keeps the second row of your first home screen free to grow into.
- **TheLauncher Feed is built in.** TheLauncher now carries the feed companion, so there's nothing to download. Turn on **Show feed**, tap **Install TheLauncher Feed** and confirm. The first time, Android asks you to allow TheLauncher to install apps. The companion stays a small separate app because Google only shows its feed to specially built apps. Building it into TheLauncher itself would make the whole launcher slower.

## Changed

- **At a Glance weather comes only from the Google app.** The Open-Meteo weather is gone, with its unit and location settings. If you had it on, Google's weather is switched on instead.
- **Tapping the weather opens a weather app, never the browser.** It opens the app picked under **Tapping the weather opens**, else your phone's weather app, else the Google app's weather.
- **Folders follow your Material You colours.** The folder background and the folder icon use the phone's Monet palette.
- **Clearer colour names.** **System** is now **Phone accent**, and **System default** is now **Automatic**.

## Fixed

- **One back closes the drawer search.** With nothing typed, closing the keyboard now also ends the search, so the next back closes the drawer. Before, it took three backs: keyboard, then search, then drawer.
- **The app update downloads TheLauncher.** The in-app updater picked the first file on the release, which was the feed companion. It now picks the launcher. The companion's file is renamed TheLauncherFeed.apk.
- **The app icon no longer vanishes and bounces when you swipe home.** The icon the app shrinks into wasn't sized in time, so it was blank for a moment, then the real icon came back with a bounce. Now it's there all the way and lands without the bounce.
- **Blackout covers more than the settings.** Folders, long-press menus, the drawer's header and the full-screen drawer are now true black in dark mode.
- **The full-screen drawer uses its colour and opacity settings.** Before, only the drawer on a sheet did.
- **Accent colour → Wallpaper picks the right colour.** It now picks the wallpaper colour Android itself would, and builds the accent from it the way Material You does.
- **Top shadow and navigation bar gradient work on any wallpaper.** Each has its own switch and shows on its own, and both are dark enough to see.
- **Hidden page dots leave no gap.** With the page dots hidden, the dock sits right under the home screen's last row, as in Hyperion.
- **Hyperion restore: two-line drawer labels.** The drawer now takes Hyperion's two-line setting straight away.
